notes.title: ALIEN FRONTIER playtest hotfix
notes.content:
I've deployed a quick hotfix that addresses some critical blocking issues. Lower priotity fixes are to come, but for now, the following critical bugs have been fixed:


[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player can grapple to a point out of bounds, locking their progress. 
[*] Fixed an issue where closing the settings screen in the title screen would cause the menu to disappear, hard-locking players. 
[*] Numerous stability and crash fixes
[/olist]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed an issue where the player can grapple to a point out of bounds, locking their progress.
[*] Fixed an issue where closing the settings screen in the title screen would cause the menu to disappear, hard-locking players.
